assessment: This work provides a major contribution to the field of oligodendrogenesis. It is a comprehensive analysis of Tensin3 function and is conceptually novel as it links the fields of transcriptional control in oligodendrocyte lineage cells with morphogenetic changes and integrin signaling-mediated cell survival. Finally, it is also the discovery of a very useful marker for remyelinating oligodendrocytes in disease conditions.
